What you actually save per second

The formula is the same one the rest of VidFare uses for credit plans: plan dollars per month, divided by credits per month, times credits per clip, divided by seconds in the clip, assuming every paid credit is used. Unused credits make the real cost per second higher. Wan 3.0 and Wan 3.0 Prime credit rates on the pricing-page compare table have no tilde. Kling 3.0, Veo 3.1, and Hailuo 2.3 are marked approximate on that table, so those rows are estimates.

Each row names the model, resolution, and audio. Audio is not stated on these Higgsfield plan rows. The four rate columns are catalog plan tiers: Plus monthly at $59/mo for 1,200 credits; Plus annual at the billed-yearly sale price of $30/mo for 1,200 credits; Ultra 3K monthly at $129/mo for 3,000 credits; Ultra 3K annual at the billed-yearly sale price of $45/mo for 3,000 credits.     What to recheck

    Whether Higgsfield starts another sale phase; VidFare's daily check re-reads the pricing page and its sale record. The tax-inclusive checkout total. Whether the annual card price changes again. Whether a plans API call without the plan-set key still returns different Plus and Starter prices than the visible cards.

    Is the Higgsfield Black Friday 2026 sale still on?

    Higgsfield's Black Friday sale is live on its pricing page until Nov 26, 2026, 7:00 PM ET (4:00 PM PT): Plus annual $30/mo and Ultra 3K annual $45/mo, billed yearly.

    When does the Black Friday sale end?

    The sale record on Higgsfield's pricing page ends at 2026-11-27T00:00:00Z, which is November 26, 2026, 7:00 PM ET (4:00 PM PT). The visible banner is only a countdown. Vendors sometimes extend sales, so VidFare rechecks after that time.

    What will I pay at checkout?

    Unknown. The pricing page says prices exclude VAT and local taxes, which are calculated at checkout. The card prices are the pre-tax figures shown on the page, not a completed checkout total.

    How is dollars per second calculated?

    A credit-plan rate is plan price divided by monthly credits, times credits per clip, divided by seconds in that clip. That math assumes every paid credit is used. A figure the vendor marks with a tilde, or that VidFare already stores as an estimate, is labeled an estimate. Seedance 2.5 has no Higgsfield plan credit rate in the catalog, so it has no plan dollars-per-second here. The monthly columns use the catalog monthly prices (Plus $59/mo, Ultra 3K $129/mo), not first-month offers.
